Help with the studio

For a problem with colouring, saving or downloads, include the collection and page number, your browser, and what happened. A screenshot may help. Do not send passwords or payment information.

Privacy requests

Send privacy questions and requests concerning information held by StoryWell Books to the email above. You can manage local artwork through storage settings. Our privacy notice explains the distinction between browser saves, correspondence and hosting records.

Artwork rights and attribution

If you believe an illustration has been included without the required permission or needs a credit corrected, identify the affected collection and page, explain your rights or authority to act, and provide supporting information. We will review the claim and take appropriate action.

The Chromalie footer marks the colouring studio. It does not replace an artist credit or establish ownership of an illustration.
